# Freshpet

> > Freshpet delivers refrigerated, fresh pet food made from real ingredients with no preservatives, combining farm-to-fridge manufacturing with veterinary nutrition expertise.

Freshpet is a pet food company specializing in fresh, natural dog and cat food brands including Vital®, Nature's Fresh®, Homestyle Creations®, and Deli Fresh®. The company emphasizes ingredient quality, sustainability, and direct-to-consumer delivery through its subscription service.

## Key Topics

- Fresh dog food
- Refrigerated pet food
- Natural ingredients
- Farm-to-fridge process
- Vital® brand
- Nature's Fresh® brand
- Homestyle Creations® brand
- Deli Fresh® brand
- Pet nutrition
- Grain-free recipes
- Quality standards
- Sustainability
- Veterinary formulation
- Fresh treats
- Subscription delivery

## Product Lines

- [Freshpet Vital® – Real Pet Food](https://www.freshpet.com/vital): Premium vet-crafted refrigerated dog food with real ingredients
- [Freshpet Nature's Fresh® – Sustainable Dog Food](https://www.freshpet.com/natures-fresh): Sustainable dog food made with regenerative farming practices
- [Freshpet® Homestyle Creations® – Gently Cooked Pet Food](https://www.freshpet.com/homestyle-creations): Gently cooked dog food made with US ingredients and home-style recipes
- [Freshpet Deli Fresh® – Refrigerated Costco Dog Food](https://www.freshpet.com/deli-fresh): Grain-free refrigerated dog food exclusively available at Costco
- [Freshpet Brand Overview – Refrigerated Pet Food](https://www.freshpet.com/freshpet): Core Freshpet brand refrigerated pet food product overview
- [Fresh Healthy Dog Treats – Dog Snacks](https://www.freshpet.com/fresh-treats): Fresh treat product lines including Dog Joy & Dognation flavors
